spans.s: (I)--one of the ten sons of स्वायम्भुव Manu. Br. II. १३. १०४;
(II)--one of the ten sons of Kardama. Br. II. १४. 9.
(III)--a god of the Sumedhasa group. Br. II. ३६. ५८.
(IV)--a son of Priyavrata: given to Yoga as he had no inclination for kingship. Vi.
(V)--a pupil of देवदर्श. Vi.

(II)--a कला of ब्रह्मा. Br. II. २६. ४५; IV. ३५. ९४.

(III)--a शक्ति;
1: Br. IV. ४४. ७२.
the goddess enshrined at काश्मीरमण्डल.
2: M. १३. ४७; २४६. ६२.
(II)--a son of Priyavrata, and appointed lord of the शाकद्वीप (प्लक्षद्वीप-वि। प्।). He divided it among his seven sons and retired to a hermitage. भा.
(III)--a son of कण्व. From him came प्रस्कण्व and other Brahmanas; ancestor of the काण्वायन द्विजस्। भा. IX. २०. 7; M. ४९. ४७; Vi. IV. १९. 6-7, ३१-2. [page२-734+ २९]

(IV)--one of the ten sons of स्वायम्भुव Manu; attained heaven by तपस्;
1: Br. II. १३. १०४;

; १४३. ३८; वा. ३१. १७.
consecrated for प्लक्ष- द्वीप;
2: Ib. ३३. 9.
a राजऋषि.
3: Ib. ५७. १२२.

(V)--one of the ten sons of Kardama and king of प्लक्षद्वीप.
1: Br. II. १४. 9, ११, ३५-7, ४०-41.
His sons, शान्तभय, शिशिर, Sukho- daya, Nanda, शिव, क्षेमक and Dhruva. These ruled the वर्षस् of the same names in the epoch of स्वायम्भुव Manu; attained heaven by तपस्। ^2 Ib. II. ३०. ३९.
(VI)--a god of Sumedhasa group. Br. II. ३६. ५८.
(VII)--(Paulastya) a sage of the Rohita group. Br.

(VIII)--a son of कण्ठ; from him काण्ठा- yana Brahmanas; married the daughter of Anupama and had a number of sons. वा. ९९. १३१.
(IX)--a son of अजमीढ and केशिनी. वा. ९९. १६९.
(X)--a sage of the IX epoch of Manu. Vi.

(I)--a son of Sunaya, and father of नृपम्- jaya (Ripumjaya-वि। प्।). भा. IX. २२. ४२; वा. ९९. २७६; Vi. IV. २१. १२-13. [page२-735+ २८]
(II)--a son of सुतपा. M. ५०. ८४.
--the snow-making rays of the sun. वा. ५३. २१.
